title: Universal Bug Triage AI Output
description: Structured triage decision produced by the LLM Intelligence Agent after analyzing canonical bug + risk + duplicate data.

severity.description: Bug severity — impact scope and user harm

priority.description: Fix priority: P1=<4h, P2=<24h, P3=<72h, P4=<1w

confidence.description: LLM confidence in this triage (≥0.80 = auto-action, <0.80 = human review)

regression.description: Whether this is a regression from a previously working state

regression_introduced_by.description: Version, deploy, or commit that likely introduced the regression

root_cause_hypothesis.description: 1-2 sentence hypothesis of what went wrong

customer_impact_description.description: Concise description of the user-facing impact

duplicate_probability.description: Probability (0-1) that this is a duplicate of an existing issue

related_issue_ids.description: IDs of similar or duplicate issues found in historical knowledge base

recommended_owner.description: Suggested team or individual owner with reasoning

suggested_labels.description: Labels to apply to the bug ticket

action_rationale.description: 1-2 sentence explanation of why this action was chosen

estimated_fix_priority.description: When this bug should be fixed

sla_breach_risk.description: Whether the current timeline risks breaching SLA commitments

ai_notes.description: Additional observations, caveats, or context for human reviewers
